expr: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const target = btns.find(b => { const t = b.innerText.trim(); return t.includes('超級管理員') || t.includes('超级管理员'); }); if (!target) return JSON.stringify({err: 'btn not found'}); target.click(); return JSON.stringify({ok: true, clicked: target.innerText.trim()}); })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const target = btns.find(b => { const t = b.innerText.trim(); return t === '確認' || t === '确认'; }); if (target) target.click(); return JSON.stringify({ok: !!target}); })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const candidates = btns.filter(b => { const t = b.innerText.trim(); return (t === '管理員' || t === '管理员') && !t.includes('超'); }); if (candidates.length === 0) return JSON.stringify({err: 'btn not found', all: btns.map(b => b.innerText.trim())}); candidates[0].click(); return JSON.stringify({ok: true, clicked: candidates[0].innerText.trim()}); })()
